userStories.title: Python rules engine mirroring SportsNot scoring and draft order
userStories.description: As the tool owner, I want a draft_oracle.rules module that exactly reproduces SportsNot scoring and draft-order rules so every projection, simulation, and backtest is scored identically to the real app. (PRD US-002)
acceptanceCriteria: Read ml/SPEC.md in full before starting: it is the binding implementation contract (ruleset, pinned stack, directory layout, data sources, leakage and honesty rules)
Implement player_points(goals, assists) = goals*1 + assists*1
Implement goalie_series_points(wins, shutouts) = (wins - shutouts)*2 + shutouts*4
Implement goalie_game_points(team_score, opp_score): 0 unless team_score > opp_score; 4 if opp_score == 0 else 2 (shutout replaces win, a 1-0 win = 4 pts, never 6)
Implement snake_order(participants, total_picks) reversing order on odd rounds, matching generateSnakeDraftOrder in packages/utils/src/lib/utils.ts

Implement roster_composition(allow_ir_slots): 5F/3D/1G, plus 1 IR_F and 1 IR_D only when allow_ir_slots is true
Roster validator rejects rosters violating composition, duplicate players, or eliminated-team players, with reason strings

userStories.description: As the tool owner, I want opponents modeled from my league's real historical picks so survival estimates reflect how these specific managers draft. (PRD US-009, part 2)

Model fit to league_draft_picks acknowledging pick sequence is NOT observable (owner-confirmed: sheets record final rosters plus snake order only): a discrete-choice model (conditional logit or Plackett-Luce) fit by marginalizing over pick sequences consistent with the observed snake order and final rosters, or a documented simpler approximation (e.g., per-manager player-selection propensity conditioned on positional need); the chosen approach and its assumptions documented in ml/README.md

userStories.title: Multi-step pick recommendation engine

Recommendation = argmax over available candidates of expected final-roster points via multi-step Monte Carlo rollout to the end of the draft: simulate opponents through all of the owner's remaining turns, fill the owner's future slots with the rollout policy, average total roster points across >=500 seeded rollouts
Rollout depth defaults to the full remaining draft; --depth and --rollouts flags trade accuracy for speed
